patterns.message: Layer violation: platform/api-client is the transport leaf — it imports NO internal package (only openapi-fetch + its own generated schema.gen). The gen-api.ts build script is exempt (it may reuse platform/config's loadRootEnv). See frontend-layering.md.
faker is test-only: wire builders live in @kotodama/core/factories — import make* from there in tests.

Independence violation: ui is pure presentation — it may self-compose via @kotodama/ui and read the generated WIRE CONTRACT type-only from @kotodama/platform/api-client (the leaf), but must NOT import the domain spine (@kotodama/core/*), platform/config, or the app. It takes data via props. See frontend-layering.md.

Import react-use per-hook from the ESM build (react-use/esm/<hook>), never the bare barrel or lib/. The barrel is CJS and pulls ~13 transitive deps (no tree-shaking); the lib/ CJS default resolves to { default: hook } under Storybook's Vite — a 'useX is not a function' crash. See react-use.md.
faker is test-only: wire builders live in @kotodama/core/factories — import make* from there in tests.
Layer violation: core/repositories may depend on @kotodama/platform/api-client only — never the domain layer (@kotodama/core/words), the design system, or apps.
faker is test-only: wire builders live in @kotodama/core/factories — import make* from there in tests.
Layer violation: core/repositories may depend on @kotodama/platform/api-client only — never the domain layer (@kotodama/core/words), the design system, or apps.
Test-only violation: the faker graph (@faker-js/faker, @kotodama/core/factories) may be imported from test files only — never from shipped code.
Layer violation: core/factories builds WIRE values over the repositories entity types — it must not import the domain model, the design system, or apps.
Layer violation: core/words derives the domain model over core/repositories — it must not import the design system or apps. It is platform-agnostic spine.

Layer violation: only apps/web/src/server (the RSC data layer) may touch raw fetchX in core/repositories. Render code reaches data through the src/server loaders. See frontend-layering.md.
